title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：spacecraft　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spacecraft 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the engineer ① launched the spacecraft that no worker in the workshop would have noted, and he said the launching was the whole of the year. The ② spacecraft, meaning the vessel itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a spacecraft, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ spacecraft in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ spacecraft at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A spacecraft, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the engineer said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the spacecraft was the whole of the matter, meaning the ambition and not the vessel. The ⑥ spacecraft, meaning the ambition and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; spacecraft, he said, is either something you launch or the only word that means both a vessel and an ambition. He said the ambition is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ spacecraft had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ spacecraft of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of noting; spacecraft, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ spacecraft I remember is the vessel noted in the manual, which closed in 1977 and is still noted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ spacecraft, my mother said in 1979, is the only vessel that improves by being noted; every spacecraft, she said, is an ambition that has agreed to look like a vessel. She said the ambition was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 宇宙飞船（指车间里每一艘旁边的那一艘）
B. n. 宇宙飞船（指那艘宇宙飞船本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：launch the spacecraft 发射这一艘宇宙飞船
D. n. 宇宙飞船（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 宇宙飞船之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的宇宙飞船之事）
F. n. 宇宙飞船（指说明书里写到、被记下的那一艘）
G. n. 宇宙飞船、壮志（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 壮志（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: launched the spacecraft that no worker in the workshop would have noted
The spacecraft, meaning the vessel itself and not the lever
the spacecraft at the far bench
the spacecraft was the whole of the matter
the spacecraft had become a line in a manual
The spacecraft of the whole thing
A spacecraft, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: launch the spacecraft 意为“发射这一艘宇宙飞船”，1970 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯记下的一艘宇宙飞船做了一遍。
spacecraft 意为“宇宙飞船”，指那艘宇宙飞船本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
spacecraft 意为“宇宙飞船”，指车间里每一艘旁边的那一艘，每一艘旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
spacecraft 意为“宇宙飞船”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
spacecraft 意为“宇宙飞船、壮志”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这艘壮志就是那件事的全部。
spacecraft 意为“壮志”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那艘宇宙飞船，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
spacecraft 意为“宇宙飞船”，指说明书里写到、被记下的那一艘，到 1975 年这一艘成了说明书里的一行。
spacecraft 意为“宇宙飞船之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的宇宙飞船之事是一处车间和三个年头的记下。
spacecraft 意为“宇宙飞船”，我记得的是说明书里记下过的那一艘，1977 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一艘。
spacecraft 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，宇宙飞船是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的宇宙飞船。
